description:
Smart SMS app with regex filters to eliminate spam in Iran An Android SMS application designed to solve the spam and advertisement problem in Iran. Iran's SMS has turned into a flood of spam messages and unwanted promotions. Misga fixes this with powerful regex filters and predefined rules that automatically silence spam and keep your notifications clean. Features
  • Regex filters with allowlist priority: Allowlist rules are evaluated first so you never miss critical OTP verification codes or banking messages.
  • Built-in Iranian spam presets: Ships with filters for Iranian spam, ads, and scams, which you can customize or replace.
  • Filter Studio: Add custom regex or substring rules, test patterns against sample text, and import/export filter lists as JSON.
  • Material 3 Expressive: Clean, intuitive UI built with modern Material Design 3.
  • Dual SIM support: Seamlessly view and manage conversations across multiple SIM cards.
Set Misga as your default SMS app so it can filter incoming messages in real time.
